description: PRODUCTION deployment for the first real test (real_signal/REAL_TEST_PLAN.md). certificate, password, signup_signed, signup_kyber and signup_one_time come from the registered account (lss-provision export-account ... deployment-hints.json). profile libsignal: the sessions run with SIGNAL_CLIENT_PROFILE=libsignal (signal-seal-official, bundle-seal 80c-1, the official request frames). handshake 1122: measured 2026-11-12 (real_signal/state/handshake-production.json): chat.signal.org sends EncryptedExtensions, Certificate (one Ed25519 certificate), CertificateVerify (Ed25519) and Finished coalesced in ONE encrypted record of 1122 bytes (16 bytes of record padding); a new server certificate of another length changes it. record_max 10240 (was 6144): a TLS frontend packs several queued WebSocket frames into one record of up to 16 KB (seen locally: tls-open-typed 8192 when two delivered messages were queued); a larger record is refused in strict mode (the session ends, the messages stay on the server). 10240 is the largest class that lowers under the 16 GB per-kernel cap (12288 does not): about four queued deliveries. signup_ciphertext 240 is Signal-Android's first text with a 108-character token (body, expireTimer, expireTimerVersion, profileKey, timestamp; padded to 80k-1 = 239), 176 the test sender's legacy layout; signup_hints 0 and 1 (Android seals 1:1 texts with RESENDABLE). Not known until the phone's first message: the post-quantum field's size (signup_pq, 37 for libsignal 0.106) and whether addresses are present; another shape is produced on demand (non-strict) or refused and recorded (strict).
